description: Browser-agent fixture: xiaojev as the local decision backend of jev-ultrafast (integrations/jev-ultrafast/), on its static travel fixture. Goal: 'Use the destination search and filters to find Design stays in Lisbon with Free cancellation, then open Casa Flora.' Raw run logs contain local machine paths and are not committed; this file is the hand-written summary.
fixture: jev-ultrafast/scripts/smoke.py (fixture.html?scenario=travel), text helper = local 27B text model

v2.behavior: loops on navigation actions; never reaches the destination form

v3.behavior: first decision selects the Destination input box (probability 1.0); the 27B text helper correctly produces 'Lisbon'; but the agent then re-fills the same field 4 times in a row instead of clicking the autocomplete suggestion, and the no-progress guard marks the run blocked

conclusion: Qualitative step forward from v2 (correct operation choice and correct text), but the model lacks web-interaction common sense (autocomplete confirmation, filter toggles). Deferred to P4 browser-domain training data.
